text:
Sam: Heads-up — I'm starting the rollout for `ff.session_cache_v2` in ~8m. Canary in us-east-1 only. Plan: 0→10→30→60→100 over 30m. DeployBot will post updates.
Maria: SG. Telemetry to watch: p50 latency, p95 latency, cache-hit-rate, and 5xx rate. Alert if p50 and p95 diverge.
Jordan: Pin note — for any cohort with qps > 1k keep v1 pinned until 60% to avoid a cold-cache thundering event. Can we tag cohorts for this? @Lia
Lia: Tagging cohorts now: `cohort=web,app-mobile,api-gateway`. I'll pin web and api-gateway at 10% until we confirm stability.
DeployBot: Deploy started: release/session-cache/2026-03-xx (id: dpl-3370001111). Canary set to 10% in us-east-1. Next auto-step in ~10m.
Sam: Quick reminder — rollback commands: `/deploy rollback dpl-3370001111` and ff disable: `/ff set ff.session_cache_v2 --percent 0`.
Maria: Observability update — small spike in p50 at 10% (us-east-1): p50 72ms → 210ms. Not firing infra alarm yet but flagging here.
Jordan: Can we pause the ramp at 10% and run a targeted bisect? Idea: split the 10% so half see v2 and half see v1 to compare under identical traffic slices.
Lia: We have cohort-split support: `/ff split ff.session_cache_v2 --cohort web --split 50/50`. Pausing ramp and will apply split on request. OpsBot: action queued.
Sam: Pausing ramp now. Lia — go ahead with the split on the web cohort.
Lia: Split applied. web cohort now 5% v2, 5% v1 (total 10%). Monitoring live metrics.
Maria: Quick triage — redis-cluster-2 p99/median suggests increased serialized cache miss latency under concurrency. Hypothesis: v2 changed key prefix leading to less shard locality.
Jordan: If key-prefix is the culprit we can revert just that change. I have a branch `session-cache/v2-no-prefix` that removes the prefix and keeps other improvements.
Sam: Sounds good. Drain to 5% and pin there while Jordan prepares the patch. If p95 drops under 400ms within 10m we can slowly resume; otherwise we disable.
DeployBot: Ramp update: scaled down to 5% as requested (dpl-3370001111). Next scheduled check in ~5m.
Maria: p95 improved to ~380ms after the split. Still watching redis RPS and CPU on cluster-2. I'll add a short note to the release doc.
Jordan: Hotfix PR opened, requesting reviews from @Sam and @Maria. If approved I'll canary the patch against the 5% v2 cohort.
Sam: Great. If anything regresses we revert the flag to 0% with `/ff set ff.session_cache_v2 --percent 0` and roll back the deploy.
Lia: Adding release note bullet: "session-cache-v2: partial rollout paused at 5% due to redis latency; hotfix PR in review; monitoring ongoing."
Sam: :thumbsup: Keeping this thread pinned for decision timeline.
